text: Assumption: Instances of concrete error domains are long-lived — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Instances of concrete error domains are long-lived — is this correct?
norm: instances of concrete error domains are long lived
assumption: Instances of concrete error domains are long-lived.
rationale: The deliberate omission of polymorphic destruction ([SWS_CORE_00136]) and the deletion of copy and move operators indicate that concrete error domains exist as long-lived or static objects.

original.text: Annahme: Langlebige Instanzen — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Der bewusste Verzicht auf polymorphe Zerstörung ([SWS_CORE_00136]) sowie die Löschung von Kopier- und Verschiebeoperatoren deuten darauf hin, dass konkrete Fehlerdomänen als langlebige oder statische Objekte existieren.
